details:
* Correct the changelog of 202610281~16.04.1ubuntu0.1+tuxcare.els1: of the
     137 certificates listed under "got a new distrust-after date", only 4 got
     a real date in certdata.txt ("Entrust.net Premium 2048 Secure Server CA",
     "Entrust Root Certification Authority - G2", "Entrust Root Certification
     Authority - EC1" and "Izenpe.com"); the other 133 only got
     CKA_NSS_*_DISTRUST_AFTER CK_FALSE, which means no date. The installed
     bundle is built from the trust objects only, so the list changed nothing
     that is trusted. No change to the certificates.
